## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Command-line arguments are now forwarded to the test runner, allowing for more flexible test execution.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The change updates the test runner initialization to include the `argv` property in the options passed to the `run` function, forwarding command-line arguments (excluding the first two) from `process.argv` to the underlying test runner. No additional logic or exported entity declarations are modified.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s)                              | Change Summary                                                        |
|------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Test Runner Argument Forwarding**<br>`bin/test-runner/index.ts` | Added `argv` to the options for `run`, forwarding `process.argv.slice(2)` to the test runner. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~2 minutes
